title: Exact restriction preserves the identity coefficient unit
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with chosen derived categories. Let F:C→D and U:C→C be additive exact functors. Let e:U≅Id and a:U⋙F≅F satisfy a_X=F(e_X) for every X. Then the composite from D(U)D(F) to D(F) obtained from the inverse exact-derived compositor and D(a) equals D(F) applied to D(e) followed by the canonical D(Id)≅Id unit, at every derived object.

proof.text: Identify a with the whiskering of e by F followed by the ordinary left unitor, using the equality of their components.

Apply compatibility of exact derivation with composition of natural isomorphisms and right whiskering, from MapDerivedCategoryMate. Use mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_id_comp to identify the remaining identity compositor, then cancel the invertible composition map.

theorem exactRestrictionDerivedIdentityUnit {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (U : C ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [U.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    (e : U ≅ 𝟭 C) (a : U ⋙ F ≅ F)
    (ha : ∀ X, a.hom.app X = F.map (e.hom.app X)) (K : DerivedCategory C) :
    ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso U F).symm ≪≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso a).hom.app K =
      F.mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso e ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C).hom.app K)
